summary.text: Gary Peters has represented Michigan in the U.S. Senate since 2015, after being first elected to the U.S. House in 2008.

paragraphs.text: Born in Pontiac, Michigan, he earned a B.A. from Alma College, an MBA, two master's degrees and a law degree, and worked for over 20 years in financial services.
Peters served on the Rochester Hills City Council from 1991 and in the Michigan Senate for two terms from 1994, and served in the U.S. Navy Reserve, rising to Lieutenant Commander.
